name: US Monthly Vehicle Assemblies
citation: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis / Federal Reserve Board. "Motor Vehicle Assemblies: Total (MVATOTASSS)." FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/MVATOTASSS. Accessed 15 July 2026.

Free to use and redistribute; see FRED Terms of Use https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal.
description:
Monthly U.S. total motor-vehicle assemblies, seasonally-adjusted annual rate (millions of units), with downstream demand (vehicle sales) and credit-cost (auto-loan rate) covariates. Application: assembly-line build-rate and JIT supplier-release planning under supply constraints.

Covariate glossary:
- motor vehicle assemblies: total U.S. motor-vehicle assemblies, millions of units, seasonally-adjusted annual rate (FRED MVATOTASSS).
- total vehicle sales: total U.S. vehicle sales, thousands of units, not seasonally adjusted (FRED TOTALNSA) - downstream demand pull.
- auto loan rate 48 month: finance rate on 48-month new-car consumer loans at commercial banks, percent (FRED TERMCBAUTO48NS) - demand/credit cost.
preprocessing: 1. Downloaded each monthly series from the FRED CSV endpoint (fredgraph.csv?id=<ID>).
2. Aligned target and covariates onto a common month-start (MS) time index.
3. Restricted to the common native span (first month where every covariate is observed through the last observed target month).
4. Forward-filled only sparse internal covariate gaps; no target imputation.
5. Dropped all calendar/timestep columns; kept a single shared ISO-8601 UTC timestamp index.
